ghost-lead.name: Ghost lead (seconds)
ghost-lead.description: How far ahead of you the ghost plays. 0 = synchronized (overlaps you); higher = the ghost leads to your right as a pacer to chase.

enable-online.name: Online victors
enable-online.description: Fetch and upload victor ghosts from the online server. Turn off to use only local recordings.

server-url.name: Server URL
server-url.description: Base URL of the Ghost Victors server (Supabase project URL). Leave default unless self-hosting.

server-anon-key.name: Server anon key
server-anon-key.description: Public anon API key for the server. Safe to share; only change if self-hosting.

seeding-mode.name: Seeding mode (admin)
seeding-mode.description: Upload your runs as official 'Bot Vikkie' seed ghosts instead of as yourself. Requires a valid admin key (below); the server rejects bot uploads without it. Leave off unless you are seeding.

admin-key.name: Admin key (private)
admin-key.description: Private key that authorizes seeding as 'Bot Vikkie'. Leave EMPTY - only the mod author sets this. When empty, all seeding UI is hidden and bot uploads are impossible.
